entry.summary:
Vendor: Buture Official
Type: Vacuum Cleaner
Price: 89.00 - 99.00 (2 variants)

At Buture, we're all about making cleaning easier and more efficient for you. Our wireless vacuums have been a hit, and we've been listening to user’s feedback to make them even better. Meet the JR700 Red, the latest and one of the finest cordless vacuums in our JR wireless vacuum series This model packs a powerful 500-watt motor, perfect for tackling pet hair and tough messes. Plus, it features an upgraded color touchscreen, up to 55 minutes of runtime, and a new tangle-free roller.

Unboxing the Buture JR700 Red

The Buture JR700 comes in a sleek, silver box, reflecting its modern design and high-quality construction. Inside the box, you will find:

  • Main body with dust cup
  • Floor brush
  • Telescopic tube
  • Crevice tool
  • Small cleaning brush
  • Battery charger
  • Wall-mounted stand
  • Two additional HEPA filters(Total of three)

Design and Features

The JR700 stands out with its striking red color, a first for Buture's wireless cordless vacuum lineup. Its design is complemented by rating marks on the main body, telescopic tube, and floor brush, enhancing its sleek appearance. The football outlook design on the top serves as an air outlet, adding a modern touch to its functional design.

Upgraded Touchscreen

The new color touchscreen on the JR700 provides real-time battery level monitoring, accurate to one percent increments. Users can easily adjust the suction power using the plus and minus buttons. The JR700 offers three suction modes:

  • Low: 18 kPa
  • Medium: 30 kPa
  • Maximum: 45 kPa

The screen also includes indicators for brush roller tangling and dust cup blockage.

Enhanced Filtration System

The JR700 features a multi-stage filtration system, including three HEPA filters that are washable and recommended to be replaced every three months. The dust cup has a generous capacity of 1.5 liters and includes a metal filter for additional filtration.

Accessories and Practical Use

The floor brush has been upgraded with hardened bristles integrated into a single tangle-free roller, making it effective on both carpets and hard floors. The V-shaped roller design ensures no hair tangling, ideal for pet owners.

The crevice tool and round brush attachments make cleaning hard-to-reach places easy. The telescopic tube adjusts from 440 to 680 millimeters, providing flexibility in use.

Noise Levels

The JR700 operates quietly, below 68dB. This design choice ensures a more peaceful cleaning experience, allowing you to use the cordless vacuum without disturbing others in your household.

LED Lights

Four LED lights on the floor brush illuminate dark areas, ensuring you don't miss any spots while cleaning.

Battery Life

The 7-cell removable battery has a capacity of 2200mAh, providing 55 minutes of runtime on low power mode and 20 minutes on high suction mode. This ensures you have ample time to clean your entire home on a single charge.

After testing the Buture JR700, it's clear that this model offers several upgrades over its predecessor, the JR600. With its powerful motor, enhanced touchscreen, and innovative design, the JR700 is a top choice for anyone seeking a reliable and efficient cordless vacuum cleaner. While it lacks the built-in dust sensor of the JR600, the JR700 more than makes up for it with its improved features and performance.

entry.title: Buture JR700 Blue Vacuum | Official Refurbished
entry.summary:
Vendor: Buture Official
Type: Vacuum Cleaner
Price: 89.00 - 99.00 (2 variants)

Step into a new era of effortless cleaning with the Buture JR700 Blue Cordless Vacuum Cleaner. Engineered with a robust 550W brushless motor, this cordless marvel conquers pet hair, dust, and debris with ease. Featuring a sleek smart touch screen and an advanced multi-filtration system, it guarantees an immaculate clean every time. The game-changing wall-mounted charging dock not only saves space but also ensures your vacuum is always ready to go. With a powerful 55-minute battery life, it’s designed for large homes and demanding tasks. Revolutionize your cleaning routine with the Buture JR700 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner – where power meets intelligence in perfect harmony.

Powerful and Efficient Cleaning

Buture JR700 cordless vacuum cleaner's adjustable suction levels make it suitable for various cleaning scenarios, ensuring that every part of your home is spotless.

550W Brushless Motor and Suction Power

High-Performance Motor: The Buture JR700 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner is equipped with a 550W brushless motor, engineered to deliver powerful and efficient cleaning performance. This motor ensures robust suction and reliable operation for a variety of cleaning tasks.

Three Adjustable Suction Levels:

  • 18KPA: Light cleaning (dusting, daily maintenance)
  • 30KPA: Medium cleaning (coffee beans, small debris)
  • 45KPA: Medium cleaning (coffee beans, small debris)

Long Battery Life

The Buture JR700 Blue is equipped with a 2200mAh 7-cell removable Li-on battery, engineered for extended performance. Here is different runtimes depending on the suction level:

  • Low Power (18KPA): 55 mins
  • Medium Power (30KPA): Balanced runtime
  • High Power (45KPA): 15 mins 

User-Friendly Smart Features

Smart Touch Screen

The Buture JR700 Blue Cordless Vacuum Cleaner is equipped with an intuitive smart touch screen that enhances user experience by providing real-time information and easy control adjustments. Key features of the smart touchscreen include:

  • Battery Level: Displays the remaining battery life, allowing you to monitor and manage your cleaning time effectively.
  • Suction Level: Shows the current suction power setting (18KPA, 30KPA, 45KPA), enabling you to adjust the suction strength based on your cleaning needs.
  • Brush Roller Status: Indicates the status of the brush roller, alerting you if there are any issues such as tangling.
  • Dust Sensor Alerts: Notify you if the dust sensor is blocked, ensuring optimal performance and efficient cleaning.

Convenience and Maneuverability

1. Wall-Mounted Charging Dock

The Buture JR700 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner features a sleek wall-mounted charging dock, designed to streamline your cleaning routine.

  • Effortless Storage: Mount the dock on any wall to keep your vacuum cleaner off the floor, freeing up space and reducing clutter.
  • Automatic Charging: Simply place this cordless vacuum cleaner on the dock, and it automatically begins charging, ensuring it’s always ready for your next cleaning session.
  • Organized and Tidy: This setup eliminates the need for separate charging cables, keeping your space neat and your vacuum always within reach.

2. Anti-Tangle Floor Brush

The Buture JR700 Blue vacuum cleaner features a short-bristle design that resists tangling and operates at a noise level of only 68 dB. Additionally, it comes equipped with an anti-tangle tool to effortlessly handle hair and other tangles.

3. LED Lights

The integrated LED lights illuminate dark corners and under furniture, making hidden dust and dirt visible and ensuring no spot is missed.

4. Flexible Movement

The brush head swivels 180° left/right and 90° up/down, allowing you to easily maneuver around furniture and reach tight spaces.

Versatile Cleaning Accessories

Comprehensive Accessory Kit

The Buture JR700 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner comes with a versatile accessory kit designed to tackle various cleaning tasks throughout your home. Here's an overview of the included accessories and their benefits:

  • Round Brush: Ideal for dusting and cleaning delicate surfaces such as curtains, upholstery, and blinds. The soft bristles gently remove dust and allergens without damaging the fabric.
  • Telescopic Tube: Extends to reach high areas like ceilings, shelves, and drapery rods. It allows for easy adjustment of length, making it convenient for users of different heights and for cleaning hard-to-reach places.
  • 2-in-1 Crevice Brush: Perfect for cleaning tight spaces and corners, such as between couch cushions, along baseboards, and in car interiors. Its narrow design ensures that no dirt or debris is left behind in those hard-to-access spots.
  • Vacuum Hose: Flexible and bendable, this tube is great for reaching under furniture, around obstacles, and in narrow spaces. It provides the flexibility needed to clean areas that are otherwise difficult to access with a rigid tool.

Advanced Filtration System

The Buture JR700 Blue Cordless Vacuum Cleaner features an advanced multi-filtration system designed to capture and contain dust, allergens, and fine particles, ensuring a cleaner home environment. Each stage of the filtration process plays a crucial role in maintaining effective cleaning and improving air quality:

  • Cyclonic Filtration: Utilizes centrifugal force to separate large particles from the airflow, preventing clogging and maintaining consistent suction power.
  • Stainless Steel Filtration: A durable, washable filter that traps medium-sized particles, enhancing the vacuum's longevity and providing a robust layer of protection.
  • Multicore Filtration: Ensures fine dust particles are efficiently separated from the air, optimizing the vacuum's overall performance and preventing fine dust from re-entering the environment.
  • HEPA Filtration: Captures 99.97% of particles as small as 0.3 microns, including allergens and pollutants, significantly improving indoor air quality and making it essential for allergy sufferers.
  • Air Outlet Filtration: This guarantees that the air expelled from the vacuum is clean and free from contaminants, contributing to a healthier living environment.

Buture JR700 Blue Specification

Charging Time 4-5 hours

Buture JR400 Portable Carpet Cleaner

While cordless vacuums are not suitable for long-pile carpets, they are ideal for most other low-pile carpets. Low-pile carpets often accumulate dust and debris that can be challenging to clean with traditional vacuums. A portable carpet cleaner like the Buture JR400 offers the perfect blend of power and convenience to tackle these challenges effortlessly.

Unmatched Power and Convenience

The Buture JR400 is designed to provide impressive cleaning power in a portable format. With adjustable suction power ranging from 18 kPa to 38 kPa and a 400W motor, this portable carpet cleaner tackles even the toughest carpet stains with ease. The touchscreen interface allows you to adjust the power settings with a simple slide of your finger, ensuring you have the right amount of power for every cleaning task.

Easy Unboxing and Assembly

When you receive your Buture JR400, you’ll appreciate the detailed instructions provided right on the box. Inside, you’ll find a multilingual manual, making assembly straightforward and hassle-free. The components include:

  • Handle: Ergonomically designed for comfortable use.
  • Brush Attachments: Versatile tools for different cleaning needs.
  • Charger and Battery: Ensures your portable carpet cleaner is always ready to go.
  • Power Plug and Cleaner Brush: Essential for maintaining your vacuum.

Quick and Simple Setup

Assembling the Buture JR400 is a breeze. Just follow these steps:

  1. Attach the handle to the main body.
  2. Connect the brush attachment of your choice.
  3. Insert the battery and power plug.

In just a few clicks, your portable carpet cleaner is ready to tackle any mess.

Versatile Cleaning Capabilities

The Buture JR400 isn’t just powerful; it’s incredibly versatile. Whether you need to clean tight corners, under furniture, or between couch cushions, this portable carpet cleaner has you covered. The brush attachments are perfect for various surfaces, and the extension bar helps you reach high and low spots effortlessly.
